title: Al-Hawiyyah al-Raqmiyyah al-Mihniyyah: Basmatun Tubni Mustaqbalan (16-18 ‘Aman)
description: A pathway for the adolescent on the threshold of university/work: building a professional digital identity (LinkedIn, portfolio), managing digital reputation, akhlaq (moral conduct) of artificial intelligence, and information security for university/professional life.

primary_reference.info: إرشادات ACM لأخلاقيات الحوسبة + نIST للأمن السيبراني

review_defects.arabic: الهوية الرقمية المهنية: بصمة تبني مستقبلاً (16-18 سنة)
review_defects.english: Al-Hawiyyah al-Raqmiyyah al-Mihniyyah: Basmatun Tubni Mustaqbalan (16-18 ‘Aman)
review_defects.why: The title is entirely transliterated instead of translated, so an English reader cannot understand its meaning. The Arabic title means 'Professional Digital Identity: A Fingerprint that Builds a Future (16-18 Years)'.

The Arabic term 'أخلاقيات' means 'ethics' in a general, modern sense. Translating it as 'akhlaq' and adding a parenthetical gloss introduces an Islamic-specific term that is not present in the source and may mislead the reader about the content's religious nature.
